author: freeCodeCamp.org
description:
Learn data structures and algorithms in Python in this beginner's course. This course covers arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, hash tables, trees, heaps, and graphs, plus recursion, searching, sorting, and interview prep. Each topic is explained with custom animations and visualizations alongside Python code examples. By the end, you will understand how the most important data structures work inside and know when to use each one.

✏️ Course created by Javid Bodurov.
Vertex Class: https://vertexclass.com
